personality: 1 iOS-Native Clean (Structure) with 8 Hand-Drawn / Journal (Palette & Warmth)
personality_one_liner: Warm, intimate, and emotionally engaging like a caring family, combining WhatsApp's structural clarity with iMessage's organic softness.

spacing.rule: Generous, breathable rhythm. Avoid cramped elements, leverage safe areas, and give chat bubbles ample margins.

do's: Use subtle glass over the ivory background for the bottom tab bar and sticky chat headers.
Use blur on the Voice Call screen over the warm abstract background.
dont's: Never blur chat bubbles or care tracker cards.
Avoid over-layering glass; keep it restricted to structural navigation.

screens.name: Home
screens.purpose: A warm dashboard combining daily care tracking and quick access to family chats.

states.loading: Gentle fade-in skeleton on care cards.
states.empty: Prompt to 'Say good morning to Mom or Dad'.
states.error: Failed to load messages -> 'Take a deep breath and try again' with a retry button.

screens.layout: Header: Large friendly greeting ('Good morning, Alex') with Profile avatar top-right. Section 1 (Care Tracker): Horizontal scroll or 3-column grid of white cards (Food, Water, Sleep) featuring circular progress rings and subtle icons. Section 2 (Recent Chats): Vertical list of Mom, Dad, and Family group, featuring custom abstract background avatars or initials, unread indicators, and a snippet of the last message.

screens.name: Chats List
screens.purpose: Dedicated inbox for the family conversations.
screens.layout: Standard iOS list layout on ivory background. Large (56x56) avatars for Mom (Coral tint), Dad (Blue tint), Group (Clay tint). Right-aligned subtle timestamps.

screens.name: Chat (Direct & Group)
screens.purpose: The core iMessage-inspired conversation view with clear, color-coded bubbles.

states.empty: Start the conversation with a suggested quick-reply chip.
states.error: Failed to send message -> inline red retry icon.

screens.layout: Glass header with back button, Avatar, Name, and Phone/Call icon. Scrollable chat area: User bubbles right-aligned (Sage `#3E6B62`), Parent bubbles left-aligned. Mom uses Soft Coral (`#E59B86`), Dad uses Soft Blue (`#6E8FC4`). In Group chat, avatars appear next to left-aligned bubbles. Bubbles have `20px` border-radius with asymmetric bottom tails. Bottom input: text field with '+' for quick actions, microphone icon for voice, and 'Send'. Include an animated 3-dot typing indicator bubble.

screens.name: Voice Call
screens.purpose: A warm, intimate, full-screen audio interface to talk to the AI parents.
screens.layout: Full-bleed abstract watercolor background (Coral for Mom, Blue for Dad) with dark gradient scrim. Top: 'Calling Mom' text. Center: Animated waveform using Reanimated, responding to voice volume. Bottom: Live conversation transcript rolling upwards. Controls at bottom: Large glass or solid pill buttons for Mute, Speaker, and a red End Call button.

screens.name: Profile
screens.layout: Settings list pattern. Top section includes an ivory-tinted card explaining 'Mom and Dad are AI companions here to support you.' Toggle for Haptics, Account settings, Data export.

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the user's color palette: Ivory (#F8F6F1) for screen backgrounds, White (#FFFFFF) for cards/surfaces, Dark Green (#1F2A26) for primary text. Sage (#3E6B62) is the main brand action color.

For Chat Bubbles: Implement an iMessage structural layout (bubbles with 20px radii, asymmetrical bottom corner tails). Use Sage for outgoing, Soft Coral (#E59B86) for Mom's incoming, Soft Blue (#6E8FC4) for Dad's incoming, and Warm Clay (#C08A61) for system/group info.
In the Group chat, both Mom and Dad will reply. Ensure their bubbles are color-coded appropriately (Coral vs Blue) with their name or small avatar next to the bubble to distinguish them.
Use 'Plus Jakarta Sans' for all text to provide a friendly, modern, and clean aesthetic, mimicking WhatsApp's cleanliness but feeling warmer.

For the Voice Call screen, implement a React Native Reanimated waveform that feels alive. Use the abstract watercolor images fetched as full-bleed backgrounds with a dark gradient scrim from the bottom to ensure the white transcript text is highly readable.
For the Care Tracker on the Home screen, use a horizontal scroll view or clean grid of 3 white cards on the ivory background. Implement circular progress indicators for Food, Water, and Sleep.
Do not use generic blue/purple UI themes. Keep the aesthetic completely rooted in the organic Sage/Coral/Blue/Ivory palette.
Ensure haptics are fired when logging care items and sending messages.
